info.name: Wattpad Customization - Times New Roman
info.description: This style changes the font for the story content on Wattpad to "Times New Roman," similar to the mobile version, to improve the reading experience.
info.additionalInfo: This is the first version of the style that changes the font for the text content when reading stories on Wattpad to "Times New Roman." This font is chosen to match the mobile version and provide a more comfortable reading experience.
